title: Vibeprint: how does an iPad sketch over the LAN reach the local coding agent?
scope: Direct LAN path only: iPad browser to local daemon, plaintext .vibeprint/ state, and the agent's MCP server reading marks.
omissions: Hosted relay path for iPads off the LAN (relay/, src/server/relay.ts)
Model-drawn quick map via Claude API (src/interpret/)

groups.label: iPad
groups.description: Local device on same LAN, user-managed

groups.label: Developer machine
groups.description: One local host: daemon, MCP, files

nodes.label: iPad browser
nodes.description: Draws sketches and marks, shows chat

nodes.label: Agent MCP
nodes.description: Process the coding agent runs for tools

notes.title: Token gate
notes.text: Non-local callers without a matching token (header, cookie or ?t=) get 401; WS upgrades are refused too.

notes.title: No daemon: files mode
notes.text: MCP edits .vibeprint/ under files.lock; waits 5s then 503, locks older than 10s count as stale.

notes.title: Single daemon
notes.text: On start it probes an existing daemon's /api/health (800ms) and reuses its port and token if alive.
